fixed = the figure two independent readers agree on (page residual, Moneycontrol Interest, the company's Mar-2018 XBRL year, its BSE results PDF); fixed = null = BLANK: the stored number was the tax and no two readers agree yet.
Directional: an entry lands only while the cell is still the archive read (src nse-html) holding `was` (or no fc); an XBRL cell outranks it.

Open list for the blank cells = the vision step (scanned 2016-17 originals); a proven figure replaces the null here, never an edit of the ledger.
